rows.name: CyclePolicy
facts: The explicit SDK alias preserves the inspected original declaration, including readonly pack/relation/law arrays and the original broad reverse-law condition type.

An outside-checkout consumer passes bidirectional strict TypeScript assignability comparisons against declarations generated from unchanged pinned original source. Positive runtime calls and 16 negative type controls also pass.

This is scoped TypeScript compatibility evidence. Complete Rust library mappings, accepted-value workflows and state-boundary acceptance remain subject to P6; a type alias cannot close those obligations.

Exact comparisons match 159 initial packs, 161 nested law/context/import inputs, 22 Node 22/macOS loader cases and 472 graph inputs. All 87 selected original cases have current evidence. Full JavaScript/value/registry/diagnostic/platform/resource and type/workflow contracts remain unresolved; these component observations do not establish full export equivalence.
